movelist.name: Wish
movelist.effect: At the end of the user’s next turn, the target regains Hit Points equal to half of its full Hit Point value. If the user targets themselves and are replaced in battle, the replacement is healed.

movelist.name: Teleport
movelist.effect: The user Teleports up to X meters, where X is its Teleporter Capability. Teleport can be used as an Interrupt at any time. Moves that targeted Teleport’s user continue through the desired target’s space if the Move allows for it as if the user hadn’t been there; single target moves simply miss.

movelist.name: Double Team
movelist.effect: The user gains 3 activations of Double Team. The user may either activate Double Team when being targeted by an attack to increase their Evasion by +2 against that attack; or when making an attack to increase their Accuracy by +2 for that attack.

movelist.name: Heal Pulse
movelist.effect: Restores 50% of the target’s max Hit Points. Heal Pulse’s user may not target itself with Heal Pulse.

abilities.name: Synchronize
abilities.effect: The foe which caused the Status Condition is given the same Status they inflicted.

abilities.name: Telepathy
abilities.effect: The user gains +1 Evasion. Whenever an Ally uses a damaging area-of-effect attack that would hit you, you may Disengage as a Free Action before the attack resolves.
